First coin after sales day; Full stall with 8 crates (no stock); Whole season on 3-day Easy finished.

Day 2 played after Continue (later run, other seed) gave identical visitors, sales, coins, stock and evening texts as unbroken run.
Repeated identical runs from fresh folders gave identical states; other seeds gave other forecasts/wholesale/visitors.
Left/finish/rush on title, put/finish/rush/accept on morning, accept on stall, Escape on evening: no state change.
